title: Core fund performance across families and methods
units: Percent, ratio, and US dollars as labelled
calculation_definition: Growth=product(1+r); geometric annual return=growth^(252/n)-1; volatility=sample SD(r)*sqrt(252); Sharpe=mean(r)*252/volatility at 0% risk-free; drawdown=wealth/running peak (including starting $1)-1.

title: Locked sentiment fusion before versus after
units: Percent, percentage points, ratio, and turnover as labelled
calculation_definition: Matched equity samples and rebalances; geometric return and drawdown use the core definitions; turnover is half the L1 target-weight change; differences are enhanced minus base.

title: Core fund growth of $1
calculation_definition: Cumulative product of one plus daily fund return.

title: Equity sentiment tilt drawdown
calculation_definition: Cumulative wealth divided by its running peak, minus one.

title: Combined-fund target weights
calculation_definition: Six peak-weight tickers are shown; all remaining assets are grouped.

title: Core fund return and risk
calculation_definition: Common-period geometric annual return versus annualised sample volatility; equity and combined funds use 252 periods, while crypto funds use 365.

title: Ten-sector daily sentiment index
calculation_definition: Ticker-day mean followed by equal weighting of observed tickers in each sector.

title: Locked sentiment fusion before versus after
calculation_definition: Matched base and one-day-lag tilt wealth and drawdown at 0 bps costs.
